newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CONTENT SEES SALES DOUBLING BY 2000.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CONTENT SEES SALES DOUBLING BY 2000.

text.p: Dutch temporary employment and services group Content Beheer NV said on Tuesday it expects to more than double group sales to 750 million guilders by 2000, compared with 316.6 million guilders in 1995.

This expectation is based on an estimated annual market growth of about 20 percent and on both organic and takeover growth, financial manager Chris Gerlach told an investors symposium on medium-sized firms in Amsterdam.
Content sees its number of outlets in the Netherlands growing to more than 100 in the next four years from the present 81 but warned profit margins would remain under pressure.
Net profits in 1995 were 14.6 million guilders.
Gerlach said Content planned to invest in automation but also had the financial strength for acquisitions, for which several scenarios would be possible.
It could acquire a number of small companies in and outside the Netherlands but the takeover of one larger Dutch or non-Dutch firm was also a possibility.

A third option was to strike a partnership deal with an international group, Gerlach said. Content's acquisition policy would focus on an increase in earnings per share and synergy effects between the partners, he added.
